# finalproject

BST260 Final Project — Fall 2026

## Project Overview

This project investigates geographic and temporal patterns in homicide
and firearm mortality in the United States using publicly available CDC
datasets.

The project includes reproducible analyses, statistical visualizations,
and documentation of findings and limitations.

## Datasets

1.  CDC Homicide Mortality (`cdcmurd`)
2.  CDC Firearm Mortality (`cdcfiremort`)

## Project Website

<https://a-l-i-c-e-CE605.github.io/finalproject/>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdcfiremort`](https://a-l-i-c-e-CE605.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcfiremort.md)
  : data from CDC on rates of mortality by firearm by state by year
- [`cdcmurd`](https://a-l-i-c-e-CE605.github.io/finalproject/reference/cdcmurd.md)
  : data from CDC on homicide rates by state by year
- [`gunleg`](https://a-l-i-c-e-CE605.github.io/finalproject/reference/gunleg.md)
  : data from RAND corporation on historical record of state
  legislatures actions on firearms control
- [`waterborne`](https://a-l-i-c-e-CE605.github.io/finalproject/reference/waterborne.md)
  : data from CDC on waterborne and foodborne illness events
